events.title: SEC approves the listing and trading of US spot Bitcoin ETPs
events.summary: The U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission approved exchange rule changes allowing multiple spot Bitcoin exchange-traded products to list and trade.
events.significance: The decision ended a decade-long US spot Bitcoin ETP approval battle and opened a mainstream brokerage route to spot Bitcoin exposure.

sources.title: SEC — Statement on the Approval of Spot Bitcoin Exchange-Traded Products

events.title: US spot Bitcoin ETPs begin trading
events.summary: The newly approved US spot Bitcoin ETPs began public trading on 11 January 2024; later SEC filings describe roughly $4.6 billion of first-day trading volume across the products.
events.significance: This converted regulatory approval into a live institutional market and created a major new source of Bitcoin demand and price discovery.

sources.title: SEC filing — spot Bitcoin ETPs commenced trading Jan. 11, 2024

events.title: GBTC converts into a spot Bitcoin ETP
events.summary: Grayscale Bitcoin Trust uplisted to NYSE Arca as a spot Bitcoin ETP following SEC approval.
events.significance: GBTC's conversion completed the legal and market saga that had produced Grayscale's 2023 court victory over the SEC.

sources.title: Grayscale SEC filing — GBTC uplisting approval

events.title: Ethereum activates Dencun and EIP-4844 blobs
events.summary: Ethereum's Dencun upgrade activated at epoch 269,568, introducing EIP-4844 blob transactions for cheaper temporary rollup data storage.
events.significance: Dencun sharply reduced data costs for many Ethereum layer-2 rollups and was a major milestone in the rollup-centric scaling roadmap.

events.title: BlackRock launches BUIDL on Ethereum
events.summary: BlackRock launched the BlackRock USD Institutional Digital Liquidity Fund (BUIDL), its first tokenized fund issued on a public blockchain, using Ethereum and Securitize infrastructure.
events.significance: BUIDL became a major bridge between traditional asset management, tokenized US-dollar yield and public blockchain settlement.

sources.title: Securitize — BlackRock Launches Its First Tokenized Fund, BUIDL

events.title: Bitcoin completes its fourth halving
events.summary: At block 840,000, Bitcoin's programmed block subsidy fell from 6.25 BTC to 3.125 BTC.
events.significance: The fourth halving continued Bitcoin's fixed monetary schedule while miners increasingly relied on transaction fees and more efficient hardware.

events.title: Runes launches at the Bitcoin halving
events.summary: The Runes protocol launched around Bitcoin block 840,000 as a new fungible-token convention built on Bitcoin.
events.significance: Runes created another wave of token issuance and blockspace demand on Bitcoin after Ordinals and BRC-20.
events.notes: Pin launch implementation/block evidence before upgrading to VERIFIED.

events.title: Hong Kong lists Asia's first spot Bitcoin and Ether ETFs
events.summary: Hong Kong Exchanges and Clearing welcomed the listing of Asia's first spot virtual-asset ETFs on 30 April 2024, including spot Bitcoin and Ether products.
events.significance: Hong Kong became an early Asian regulated market for spot Bitcoin and Ether exchange-traded funds.

sources.title: HKEX — Asia's First Spot Virtual Asset ETFs

events.title: SEC approves rule changes for US spot Ether ETPs
events.summary: The SEC approved exchange rule changes to list and trade shares of Ether-based exchange-traded products on NYSE Arca, Nasdaq and Cboe BZX.
events.significance: The order cleared the central exchange-rule barrier for US spot Ether products and extended regulated spot-crypto ETP access beyond Bitcoin.

sources.title: SEC — Ether-Based Exchange-Traded Products Approval Order

events.title: DMM Bitcoin reports a major Bitcoin theft
events.summary: Japanese exchange DMM Bitcoin reported an unauthorized outflow of Bitcoin in late May 2024.
events.significance: The theft became one of the largest centralized-exchange security incidents of 2024.
events.notes: Add DMM Bitcoin/Japanese regulatory primary notice and exact amount before VERIFIED.

events.title: Saxony sells almost 50,000 seized Bitcoin
events.summary: Saxon authorities sold approximately 49,858 BTC seized in the Movie2k case between 19 June and 12 July 2024, generating about €2.64 billion in proceeds held provisionally for the criminal proceeding.
events.significance: The sale became one of the largest government-linked Bitcoin liquidations and a major real-time market narrative.

sources.title: Saxony — Emergency sale of almost 50,000 Bitcoins completed

events.title: Mt. Gox begins Bitcoin and Bitcoin Cash repayments
events.summary: The Mt. Gox rehabilitation trustee announced that repayments in Bitcoin and Bitcoin Cash had been made to some rehabilitation creditors through designated exchanges.
events.significance: The first crypto repayments arrived more than a decade after Mt. Gox collapsed, closing part of one of crypto's longest-running creditor sagas.

sources.title: MtGox — Notice Regarding Repayment in Bitcoin and Bitcoin Cash

events.title: WazirX loses more than $230 million in a multisig-wallet attack
events.summary: WazirX reported a cyber attack on a multisig wallet involving losses exceeding $230 million.
events.significance: The incident became one of 2024's largest exchange/custody thefts and a major test of multisig operational security.

sources.title: WazirX — Preliminary Report: Cyber Attack on WazirX Multisig Wallet

events.title: US spot Ether ETPs begin trading
events.summary: Spot Ether exchange-traded products began trading on US exchanges on 23 July 2024 following SEC rule approval and effectiveness of registration statements.
events.significance: Ether joined Bitcoin as a crypto asset available through regulated US spot exchange-traded products.

sources.title: Grayscale SEC filing — ETHE/ETH begin trading

events.title: Solana meme-token launch platforms accelerate token creation
events.summary: Solana-based meme-token launch platforms, especially Pump.fun, dramatically lowered the friction for creating and trading new tokens during 2024.
events.significance: The model became a defining mechanism of the 2024 meme-coin cycle and changed how speculative tokens were launched.
events.notes: Needs primary platform launch/volume evidence before scoring.

events.title: Dogwifhat becomes a defining Solana meme coin
events.summary: Dogwifhat rose from a meme-token launch into one of Solana's largest meme-coin communities during 2024.
events.significance: The project became a visual symbol of Solana's meme-coin boom and community-funded marketing culture.

events.title: Polymarket prediction markets enter mainstream political coverage
events.summary: Polymarket's election-related markets received substantially increased public and media attention during the 2024 US election cycle.
events.significance: The period helped move crypto-based prediction markets from a niche application into mainstream discussion of forecasting and market-based probabilities.
events.notes: Needs neutral, dated volume/coverage evidence before canonical publication; do not turn market prices into an election prediction.

events.title: Bhutan's state-linked Bitcoin mining and holdings gain global attention
events.summary: Public attention grew around Bhutan's state-linked Bitcoin mining activity and cryptocurrency holdings.
events.significance: The story added a distinctive sovereign-mining model to government involvement in Bitcoin.
events.notes: Attach official Bhutan/Druk Holding or high-authority chain-analysis evidence before VERIFIED.

events.title: Bitcoin trades above $100,000 for the first time
events.summary: Bitcoin rose above $100,000 for the first time on 5 December 2024; Reuters reported an intraday high of $103,649.
events.significance: Crossing six figures was a major psychological and cultural price milestone after sixteen years of Bitcoin history.
events.notes: Use Reuters' quoted market high rather than presenting one universal exchange price.
